| Platform | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | `Unhidden-windows-x64.exe`, a single file with nothing to install |
| macOS 11+ (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `Unhidden-macos.dmg` |
| Linux and Steam Deck | `Unhidden-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Ubuntu, Debian, Mint | `Unhidden-linux-amd64.deb` |

**First launch.** None of the builds are code-signed, so each OS asks once.

- **Windows:** at "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **macOS:** right-click the app and choose **Open**. On macOS 15 and later, try to open it once, then go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**.
- **Linux and Steam Deck:** right-click the AppImage, then Properties → Permissions → allow executing. On Steam Deck, use Desktop Mode.
